### How Can We Aim to Have the Same Attitude as Jesus?
Author: Meg Bucher
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/how-can-we-aim-to-have-the-same-attitude-as-jesus-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Philippians 2:5
Points:
- Following Jesus requires examining our inward heart attitudes rather than just monitoring outward behavior.
- God does not demand flawless perfection from us, but calls us to yield daily to the Holy Spirit for growth.
- Believers aim for Christ's mindset by pursuing humility, prioritizing others above themselves, and rejecting selfish ambition.
- Reflecting Jesus involves replacing complaining with gratitude, obeying God's Word, and holding on to joy.

### Jesus Emptied Himself
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/jesus-emptied-himself
Passage: Philippians 2:7b-11
Points:
- Jesus stands as the supreme model of selflessness by releasing His hold on His rightful divine privileges.
- In emptying Himself, Christ retained full deity while voluntarily setting aside the independent use of His divine attributes.
- He lived in absolute submission and dependence upon the Father's timing, guidance, and will.
- His humility culminated in total surrender by enduring the shameful, excruciating death of a criminal on a cross.
- Because of His obedience, God exalted Him to the highest place, and fixing our eyes on Him leads us to live selflessly.
